📊 Electoral Liquidity & Dollar Volume

Political markets represent the highest single dollar volume sector on Kalshi, with the 2024 Presidential Election recording over $100M+ in aggregate open interest. Key dynamics include:

  • Battleground Tipping Points: Large rapid moves (≥ $0.20) on election night as key precinct returns cross statistical certainty thresholds.
  • Congressional Control Margins: House and Senate composition contracts resolving based on official Clerk rolls.
  • Off-Year Gubernatorial Cycles: Virginia and New Jersey 2025 executive races offering high volatility in primary phases.
